says: The law 'T318 kept dirty unsaved locked malformed or failed candidates never stop later cleanup or turn merge red' runs close to vitest's 60-second limit, so on a loaded laptop it times out with no assertion failing.
proof: nice -n 19 pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 .agents/skills/lead/scripts/catchup.cleanup.test.ts -t T318, run twice at a load average near 17: once 'Error: Test timed out in 60000ms', once all 32 passed. The law runs 3 cases of 5 cleanup kinds, each a full catchup.sh run on the shell stub.
cost: A red local run that is not a real failure, under the caps AGENTS.md sets for a busy laptop; the next agent may rerun it until green.
